# ClawNeuro

ClawNeuro is a planned neuroimaging-native extension of ClawBio.

Core idea:
- modular skills + orchestrator
- local-first
- BIDS-native
- provenance-first
- publication-ready outputs

Do not build:
- a monolithic LLM neuroimaging agent
- a replacement for fMRIPrep / MRIQC / QSIPrep / XCP-D
- a clinical system

Build:
- wrappers around trusted neuroimaging tools
- strict skill contracts
- BIDS Derivatives outputs
- deterministic methods text
- reproducibility bundles
- benchmarkable public workflows

v1 scope:
- DICOM/NIfTI intake
- BIDS validation and audit
- de-identification readiness
- MRIQC
- anatomical + BOLD preprocessing
- task GLM
- resting-state connectivity post-processing
- reporting + provenance

v1.1:
- diffusion preprocessing / reconstruction

future:
- EEG/MEG via MNE-BIDS
- PET / ASL / broader multimodal support

Non-negotiable rules:
- BIDS first
- no result without provenance
- no derivative without dataset_description.json + GeneratedBy
- no AI-generated scientific claim without traceability
- task GLM != resting-state connectivity path

Read first:
- docs/PROJECT-CHARTER.md
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ROADMAP.md
- docs/BENCHMARK-SPEC.md
- prompts/CODEX_MASTER_PROMPT.md
